component.name: Airdrop Linux
component.summary: Share files and clipboard across your devices

description.p: Share files, ZIP archives and clipboard text between your Linux computer and mobile devices. Includes a local file server, a desktop file manager and a web app.

Sharing across devices requires Tailscale installed and configured separately on the host. Closing the window can keep sharing active with background permission. Stop sharing and quit ends the bundled server.
